creations.desc: At turn start, "24" gains 15 Aliemus. At turn start, if "24" is in the "Depressed Persona" state at turn start, she gains an additional 24 Aliemus; if in the "Manic Persona" state, her Temporary Crit. Rate and Temporary Crit. DMG +24%.
